finalText:
The bug was intermediate rounding in USD. The code was rounding after applying each coupon, then rounding again after currency conversion. This caused a cents-off error whenever a percent discount stacked with conversion.

Here's what happened: after applying a percent coupon, you'd get fractional cents (like 17.982). Rounding that to 17.98 USD before converting meant the conversion math started from the wrong base. When 17.98 converted to GBP, it hit a different rounding boundary than 17.982 would have.

The fix was to apply all discounts without intermediate rounding, convert to the target currency with full precision, then round exactly once at the end. All 40 tests pass now.
